harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves a persistent local APT repository from /srv/local-apt. APT installed and executed antrieb-local-demo 1.0-1 from node1 while all usual remote repositories were unreachable. The repository service, package, and metadata survived the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created and enabled local-apt-repo.service on port 8080.
Configured APT to block remote repositories while allowing direct access to node1's local repository.
Updated APT indexes and installed the package from http://10.100.50.10:8080.
Restarted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed and all required state recovered.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: The local package was built under /srv/local-apt; the enabled service served valid package metadata over node1:8080.

evidence.requirement: Use the local repository while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: APT remote traffic was directed to an unreachable proxy with a direct exception for node1. All usual remote repositories failed while APT successfully fetched the local Packages index.

evidence.requirement: Install and run a package from the local repository
evidence.summary: APT policy identified node1:8080 as the candidate origin, downloaded the package from it, and dpkg confirmed version 1.0-1 installed; its executable ran successfully.

The healthy pre-restart boot ID was 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594. Native reboot was acknowledged, SSH became unavailable during restart, and the new boot ID was 69950fe1-2d27-44a4-b39b-655a042943fa. Afterwards the enabled repository service was active and listening, HTTP returned 200, repository data retained its checksum, and the installed package remained healthy and executable.
